title: The Twelve Apostles and Jesus' True Family

questions.question: In the synagogue on the Sabbath, what physical ailment did a man have that Jesus was about to heal?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:1 (ESV): "Again he entered the synagogue, and a man was there with a withered hand."

questions.question: Why were the people watching Jesus closely in the synagogue?
options: To see whether he would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse him
Because they wanted to see a miracle to believe
To learn how a withered hand could be restored
To see if he would ask for money
questions.correctAnswer: To see whether he would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse him
questions.explanation: Mark 3:2 (ESV): "And they watched Jesus, to see whether he would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse him."

questions.question: Before healing the man, Jesus asked the people an unanswerable question. What was it?
options: "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to kill?"
"Is it lawful to break the traditions of the elders?"
"Which is greater, the temple or the one who heals?"
"Why do you doubt the Son of Man?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to kill?"
questions.explanation: Mark 3:4 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to kill?' But they were silent."

questions.question: How did Jesus feel as He looked around at them with anger, before He said "Stretch out your hand"?
options: He was grieved at their hardness of heart
He was resigned to their disbelief
He was afraid of their judgment
He was joyful that they were silent
questions.correctAnswer: He was grieved at their hardness of heart
questions.explanation: Mark 3:5 (ESV): "And he looked around at them with anger, grieved at their hardness of heart, and said to the man, 'Stretch out your hand.'"

questions.question: After the healing on the Sabbath, the Pharisees went out and immediately held counsel with what group to destroy Jesus?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:6 (ESV): "The Pharisees went out and immediately held counsel with the Herodians against him, how to destroy him."

questions.question: Because the crowd was so massive, what did Jesus tell His disciples to have ready for Him, lest the crowd crush Him?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:9 (ESV): "And he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him because of the crowd, lest they crush him,"

questions.question: Whenever the unclean spirits saw Jesus, they fell down before Him and cried out what?
options: "Do not send us to the abyss!"
questions.explanation: Mark 3:11 (ESV): "And whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, 'You are the Son of God.'"

questions.question: Jesus appointed twelve (whom He also named apostles) so that they might be with Him and He might send them out to do what?
options: To preach and have authority to cast out demons
To collect taxes for the kingdom
To build churches in every town
questions.correctAnswer: To preach and have authority to cast out demons
questions.explanation: Mark 3:14-15 (ESV): "And he appointed twelve... so that they might be with him and he might send them out to preach and have authority to cast out demons."

questions.question: What surname did Jesus give to James and John, the sons of Zebedee?
options: Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder
Iscariot, that is, Man of Kerioth
questions.correctAnswer: Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder
questions.explanation: Mark 3:17 (ESV): "James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of James (to whom he gave the name Boanerges, that is, Sons of Thunder);"

questions.question: When Jesus' family heard the crowds were so big they could not even eat, what did they say and try to do?
options: They went out to seize him, for they were saying, "He is out of his mind."
They brought him food so he wouldn't faint
They rebuked the crowd for their selfishness
They asked to be his first disciples in secret
questions.correctAnswer: They went out to seize him, for they were saying, "He is out of his mind."
questions.explanation: Mark 3:21 (ESV): "And when his family heard it, they went out to seize him, for they were saying, 'He is out of his mind.'"

questions.question: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said Jesus was possessed by Beelzebul, and by what authority did He cast out demons?
options: By the power of Roman idols
questions.explanation: Mark 3:22 (ESV): "And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem were saying, 'He is possessed by Beelzebul,' and 'by the prince of demons he casts out the demons.'"

questions.question: Jesus called them to Him and spoke in parables, asking, "How can Satan cast out Satan?" What did He say about a kingdom divided against itself?
options: That kingdom will be given to its neighbors
That kingdom must purge its leaders
questions.explanation: Mark 3:24 (ESV): "If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand."

questions.question: Jesus said no one can enter a strong man's house and plunder his goods unless he first does what?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:27 (ESV): "But no one can enter a strong man's house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man. Then indeed he may plunder his house."

questions.question: Jesus states that all sins and blasphemies will be forgiven, except for whoever blasphemes against whom?
questions.explanation: Mark 3:28-29 (ESV): "...but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin"

questions.question: When told that His mother and brothers were outside seeking Him, who did Jesus say are His brother and sister and mother?
options: "Whoever does the will of God, he is my brother and sister and mother."
"Only the twelve whom I have chosen."
"Those who give all they have to the poor."
questions.correctAnswer: "Whoever does the will of God, he is my brother and sister and mother."
questions.explanation: Mark 3:35 (ESV): "For whoever does the will of God, he is my brother and sister and mother."

key_verse_text: "For whoever does the will of God, he is my brother and sister and mother."
